external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A person who signs in through the identity broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store who is vouched for by the franchise's identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.

external_entities.name: identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider used by franchise colleagues to vouch for them.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system from which group membership changes and leaver status originate.
external_entities.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, accepts franchise identity-provider sign-in, and provides public signing keys.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses the token's groups to authorize price changes and transaction voids across stores.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and their groups.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what that log records, whether it covers the franchise route, or whether the directory or the log are encrypted where they sit.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in through the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token carrying a staff ID and group list for use by the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token. The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.authentication: token signed by the identity broker

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the signing key from the broker to check token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: public half of the signing key

data_flows.name: keep signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker keeps the token-signing key in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: maintain directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains its directory of colleagues and groups.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The broker pulls group-membership and leaver changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night, and that is also how leavers stop being colleagues.

data_flows.name: vouch for colleague
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague and the broker accepts that as a sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which colleagues the identity provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: write sign-in
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker, store admin console, key store, directory, and audit log run or are kept.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: franchise environment
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-controlled environment containing franchise colleagues and their own identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.
